reviewer: ChatGPT /root visual inspection; not a qualified legal review
inspection_basis: All nine exact side-by-side, overlay and difference PNGs were hash-verified after transfer and visually inspected at their original resolution.
metric_interpretation: Mean pixel difference measures changed pixels including case content and layout. White background area strongly affects the number. It does not establish semantic fidelity, legal correctness or human acceptance.

The selected role is Claim reader because this captured recorded operation is fact extraction. The source text and question belong to the actual rent-increase case.
The highlighted passage is legible and bound to the visible fact. Surrounding source prose is intentionally dimmed during this focus beat; Open full source remains available.

additional_limits: Dense legal/source prose benefits from pausing the film or opening the full source.
The stills do not independently establish playback timing; the continuous film and motion gate provide that separate evidence.
Accepted visual deviations are documented; pixel identity with illustrative concepts is not claimed.
